summary_data.why_matters: 이 공개는 NVIDIA가 합성 데이터 리스타일링(Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer)이 실제 로봇 정책 성능에 미치는 영향을 통제된 실험으로 정량화하려는 시도를 보여준다. **합성 데이터 기반 sim-to-real 전이**의 재현 가능한 벤치마크를 제공함으로써 로봇 파운데이션 모델 생태계의 투명성과 검증 가능성을 높이는 의미가 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 Cosmos 플랫폼을 단순 월드모델 제공을 넘어 **VLA(Vision-Language-Action) 정책 학습과 합성 데이터 생성의 end-to-end 레시피**로 확장하며, Omniverse·Isaac 생태계와 연계된 로봇 AI 인프라 포지션을 강화하고 있다.
summary_data.focus_angle: 자동차·로봇 OEM 입장에서는 실데이터 379개에 합성 중복 데이터를 더해 93% 이상의 조작 성공률을 달성한 사례가 **데이터 수집 비용을 낮추는 실전 가이드**로 활용될 수 있으며, 교란 환경에서도 82.9%의 견고성을 보인 점은 휴머노이드·매니퓰레이션 로봇의 실환경 배치 신뢰성 검증에 참고 자료가 된다.

headlines.body: A new version of DLSS 5 on NBA 2K27 was just released, and modders have already extracted it and are running it on unsupported games. Modders are comparing performance between the older and newer Neural Rendering (NR) model and found it up to 40% faster than the previous one. While many are still experimenting with leaked and first-release builds, Renan Maniero has already extracted the new 310.9.16.0 DLSS NR build, letting other modders use it in unsupported games and compare performance. Gaming Optimized on X compared the new NR model to the old one and found massive improvements of up to 90% in The Witcher 3 running DLSS 5 natively. Running a full NR model to modify your game's image is resource-intensive, just as LLMs require a lot of RAM; DLSS NR does, too. To improve performance, Nvidia made the AI model 24% smaller, using 20% less VRAM at 4K, and, according to Nvidia, processes its neural rendering workload up to 2x faster. I Uploaded a new Video about the new DLSS 5 Model that got released by Nvidia.The new model can be up to 90% Faster (The Witcher 3) compared to the older one, but the performance boost varies depending on the game tested.Video link below!!https://t.co/aohckywbty https://t.co/8dwSHMqIig October 16, 2026 Typically, improving an AI model means increasing its parameters and size—in other words, giving it a bigger brain. However, because consumer GPUs have limited, non-upgradable VRAM, Nvidia can't improve by adding a bigger model; instead, the AI needs to become more efficient while reducing resource usage. These comparisons were much easier than switching back and forth between updates, since the latest version still includes the older model as a preset. The new DLL has two Neural Rendering presets: Preset A is the old model, and Preset B is the newer model. As with many other DLSS 5 experiments like those Valery Kryzhanovsky does, DLSS is injected into the graphics pipeline using RenoDX or OptiScaler, both of which let you tweak the DLL settings to get different results. To run DLSS NR on older RTX GPUs, the modding community also modified the runtime to support RTX 20-series GPUs, as the OptiScaler GitHub README notes. Nvidia plans to release DLSS 5 to RTX 40-series GPUs , but there are no reports of it officially coming to RTX 30- or RTX 20-series cards; the modding community seems to have done it anyway.

headlines.body: 엔비디아 임원이 소비자용 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 품귀 원인을 메모리 공급 부족 때문이라고 말했다. 이다 케이타 엔비디아 개발자 협력 부문 부사장은 16일 삼성동 코엑스에서 열린 RTX 스파크 출시 행사 직후 기자와 만나 "게이머를 포함한 일반 소비자가 겪는 수급 난항은 GPU뿐 아니라 D램 등 반도체 산업 전반의 공급망 문제"라며 "엔비디아가 통제할 수 있는 영역이 아니다"라고 했다. 소비자 GPU 품귀 관련 질문에 대한 답이었다. 소비자용 그래픽카드 인기 모델은 수량이 제한돼 추첨이나 선착순으로 판매된다. 엔비디아 소비자용 최상위 제품 RTX 5090은 최대 1500만원 이상에 거래되고 있다. 세금 포함 권장소비자가격의 약 5배다. 이다 부사장은 이날 출시한 RTX 스파크를 예로 들며 "RTX 스파크가 할 수 있는 작업을 고려하면 다른 컴퓨터를 구매하는 것보다 장기적으로 엄청난 돈을 절약할 수 있다"고 말했다. 1000억개 이상 매개변수를 가진 AI 모델을 기기 안에서 돌릴 수 있다면서 "외부 클라우드 서비스를 거치지 않으므로 토큰 사용 비용이 없다"고도 했다. 비싸지만 돈값은 한다는 의미다. RTX 스파크 기반 노트북 가격은 약 470만원부터 시작한다. 사양에 따라 판매가는 최대 1000만원까지 올라간다. 회사는 가격이 높은 이유로 메모리 가격 상승을 꼽았다. 행사장에서 만난 엔비디아 관계자는 "개발 당시 128GB는 감당할 만한 가격대였고 이를 최적점으로 봤다"며 "메모리 가격이 이렇게까지 오를 줄은 예상하지 못했다"고 말했다.

headlines.body: For decades, most data center infrastructure evolved as a collection of largely independent technology domains. Processor performance improved through architectural and process innovations, memory and networking advanced on their own roadmaps, and facility infrastructure scaled predictably to support successive generations of hardware. Moore's Law, standardized interfaces, and steady technology scaling allowed operators to upgrade servers, networks, and facilities on different timelines with confidence. AI has fundamentally changed that model. Today’s accelerator platforms derive their performance not from compute engines alone, but from the interaction of memory subsystems, networking fabrics, advanced packaging technologies, power delivery systems, and cooling infrastructure. As AI deployments scale, the traditional separation between these domains is diminishing. What was historically viewed as a collection of independent infrastructure layers is now operating more as a tightly coupled system in which decisions made in one domain influence the outcomes across others. Unlike traditional enterprise workloads, where performance improvements could often be realized within a single subsystem, large-scale AI training and inference are constrained by the efficiency with which data moves across the entire platform. Every training iteration requires continuous movement and synchronization of model parameters, activations, and gradients across thousands of accelerators, making memory capacity, memory bandwidth, interconnect latency, and communication overhead as critical to performance as the compute engines themselves. Hence, idle accelerators represent stranded capital, wasted energy, and lower returns on some of the most expensive infrastructure investments in the data center. Evidence from recent AI infrastructure deployments Recent AI infrastructure deployments illustrate these dependencies clearly. Modern accelerator platforms are increasingly designed around the integration of compute, memory, networking, power delivery, and cooling systems rather than advances in any single component. The adoption of high-bandwidth memory has highlighted the growing importance of memory bandwidth and advanced packaging, while power availability and cooling capacity have emerged as major deployment constraints for large-scale AI clusters. Together, these developments demonstrate that system performance increasingly depends on co-design rather than independent optimization. The clearest evidence of this shift is organizational as much as technical. Nvidia'sintegration of GPUs, NVLink, NVSwitch, networking, CUDA, and DGX systems, Google's co-design of TPUs with its software stack and data center infrastructure, and the emergence of vertically integrated platforms such as AWS Trainium and Microsoft's Maia all reflect the same underlying trend. It combines a C-RADIOv4-SO400M vision encoder with a 10-layer mBART decoder that consumes the visual sequence as a causal prefix. The release uses dynamic rectangular NaViT preprocessing, content-normalized coordinates, grouped-query self-attention (16 query heads and 8 key/value heads), a 72,505-token multilingual tokenizer, and chart-aware output through the ` ` token.
